unit_tests.scope: Inherited unit coverage plus 17 recovery-domain tests and 3 route-overlay tests.

production_build.includes: TypeScript project build and Vite production output

design_lint.warning_scope: Orphaned-token declarations in the existing mirrored design context. No runtime token error was found; warnings remain recorded.

environment.launch: Compatible serverless Chromium launch arguments; no single-process flag; isolated browser contexts. HMR disabled for stable lifecycle testing.

verified_workflows: Request creation rejects invalid input and preserves unapproved consent.
Journey preview does not approve; explicit approval permits progression; changes invalidate stale approval.
Chronological pickup, carrier cancellation, retained physical custody, restoration, receiver data hold, explicit clearance and completion.
JSON and CSV download, invalid-import protection, valid import and safe reload.
Actual city, vehicle, receiver and device WebGL views; Decisions and Results surfaces; desktop and mobile viewport rendering.
Mobile overflow checks across workspaces, English, keyboard focus restoration and legacy route aliases.
Forced WebGL initialization failure retains interactive map and planning controls.
Actual WEBGL_lose_context transitions to interactive map and recovers through explicit 3D retry.

automated_accessibility.scope: Automated checks on these surfaces, not a complete accessibility certification.

replace_all_acceptance.source: Complete archive extracted over a clean git-archive checkout of the baseline commit.
replace_all_acceptance.results: All passed. Application, API, server and script content matched the final source. Latest E2E formatting and release documentation were subsequently overlaid and checked.
replace_all_acceptance.archive_contract: Repository-root contents; no wrapper directory; no manual obsolete-file deletion; no node_modules, dist, credentials or git metadata.

limitations: All operating inputs and events are fictional planning assumptions.
Planning is deterministic greedy pre-departure insertion, not global optimization or live-position rerouting.
Local/imported history is unauthenticated demonstration data, not a shared operational audit record.
No actual carrier/receiver integration, physical collection, data erasure, treatment, payment or external deployment.
No live paid-model request; model output quality and real deployed endpoint behavior were not established.
Software WebGL does not certify physical-device frame rate, battery use or thermal performance.
Eight documented design-lint warnings remain; automated accessibility coverage is limited to the listed surfaces.
